title: OSM power equipment: Southern Zone snapshot
description: Mapped substations and transformers in the Geofabrik India Southern Zone extract; incomplete community mapping, not verified utility equipment
notes: Regional extract, not exhaustive national coverage. All LGD codes unresolved. 2398 mapped nodes and 5328 mapped ways; 7 power relations excluded. Ways use their first mapped perimeter vertex, not a surveyed center. Voltage is an unverified OSM tag. No capacity, ownership, availability or connection-feasibility inference. No usernames, user IDs or changeset metadata. See docs/analytics/PART12_SOURCE_REVIEW.md.
